touchpoints.when: end of the first shift, before they leave
touchpoints.opening: Quick check before you head home, two minutes.
touchpoints.closing: Thanks. If anything comes up before your next shift, call the shift lead line.

questions.text: Did you get boots, gloves and a vest that fit?
questions.probe: Anything you had to borrow or go without?

routes.answer: No kit, or wrong-size boots or gloves
routes.action: Swap the size from the cage before their next shift

questions.text: Do you know when your next shift starts?

routes.answer: Does not know their next shift or has no schedule
routes.action: Send the schedule by text before they sleep

questions.text: Did you get your break tonight?

routes.answer: No break taken
routes.action: Set the break time for the next shift and tell the shift lead

questions.text: Do you know who to call if you can't make a shift?

routes.answer: Does not know the call-out number
routes.action: Add the number to their phone now

questions.probe: Where was it, and what happened?

routes.answer: Something felt unsafe or someone got hurt
routes.action: Walk the area with them before the next shift

routes.answer: Someone's conduct towards them
routes.action: Hand over the same day; do not investigate in the check-in

touchpoints.when: start of the sixth or seventh shift, in the first ten minutes
touchpoints.opening: One week in. Three minutes on how it's really going.
touchpoints.closing: Thanks. Anything we said we'd fix, you'll hear back on within a week.

questions.text: Is the work what you expected when you said yes?
questions.probe: What's different from what you were told?

routes.answer: The work is not what they were told
routes.action: Talk it through; tell the recruiter what the ad got wrong

routes.answer: A theme across new hires

questions.text: Is your schedule the one you agreed to?

routes.answer: Schedule differs from what was agreed
routes.action: Swap the shift back before it becomes a pattern

questions.text: How long is your trip in, and is it still working?

routes.answer: The trip no longer works because the shift changed
routes.action: Change the start time or the shift before the next week's schedule goes out

routes.answer: Long trip, still working

questions.text: Has anything happened that you didn't know how to handle?

routes.answer: A training gap
routes.action: Book the module on their next shift

routes.answer: Someone treated them badly or harassed them

questions.text: Do you have a buddy you can ask on shift?

routes.answer: No buddy, or the buddy is never on
routes.action: Assign someone on the same nights

touchpoints.when: the week after the first payday
touchpoints.opening: A month in. Three minutes, and nothing you say goes back to your supervisor without your say.
touchpoints.closing: Thanks. You'll hear back within a week on anything we can change.

questions.text: Was your first pay right, hours and rate?

routes.answer: Pay wrong or missing
routes.action: Raise it with payroll today and tell them when it will be fixed

questions.text: Are your hours what you expected?

routes.answer: Fewer or more hours than agreed

questions.text: Is anything from your first week still not sorted?

routes.answer: Something raised on day 1 or day 7 is still open
routes.action: Close it, or tell them today why it can't be

questions.text: Would you like more hours, fewer, or the same?

routes.answer: Wants more or fewer hours
routes.action: Offer open shifts or trim the schedule

questions.text: Is there anything about how you're managed we should know?

routes.answer: A concern about their supervisor's conduct
A wish about how shifts are run

close_the_loop.done: You mentioned your boots didn't fit. The new pair is in your locker.
close_the_loop.in_progress: You asked about your start time. I've asked the site lead and you'll have an answer by Friday.
close_the_loop.declined: You asked to move to days. We can't this month because days are full; I've put you first on the list.

capture: site, hire id, day, date done, tier if something came back, two-word theme
